answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quartz of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The beacon holds work receipts rather than names, so the gale of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
